messages:
sam: Heads up — we're getting a surge of token-decoding errors for quant-v4b in ap-southeast during nightshift. Error rate ~4.2% on the canary slice. Thinking we should soft-pin the runtime for quantized model group to avoid user-facing failures. :warning:

deploybot: Automated: pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.2, model_group=quantized, region=ap-southeast, id=pin-6498765432, started=2026-03-23T02:10Z. Rollback trigger: error_rate>3% for 5m.

maya: Can we scope this to ap-southeast only? that's where the spike is. Avoid global pin if possible.

lisa: +1 to region-scoped pin. Also note: SDK 2.7 has a small signature change for KV cache marshaling — clients on 2.7 may hit minor incompat with runtime v3.2. SDK 2.8.1 with the shim is ready to roll in ~30m. If we pin runtime we should block unpin until SDK patch is live.

zach: Oncall here — confirming we see GC-related spikes correlating with long-seqs. Rolling back runtime is less disruptive than model rollback. We can also reroute traffic to qn-v4b-lite variant as a temporary fallback.

sam: Plan: 1) keep regional pin applied; 2) route 20% of traffic to qn-v4b-lite; 3) wait for SDK 2.8.1 publish + 1 full canary cycle (30m) before considering unpin. Applying routing change now:
```
route_set region=ap-southeast model=quant-v4b split={primary:80, fallback-lite:20}
```

maya: added a canary flag to the rollout plan and updated the rollout doc. Will watch latency + error metrics.

deploybot: Note: pin window policy enforced. To unpin manually run: `/pin remove pin-6498765432` (requires eng-releases approver). Auto-unpin disabled while SDK patch open.

oncall-bot: Alert cleared: after prefix-cache tweak error rate fell to 1.1% on the baseline slice. Continuing to monitor for 10m.

lisa: SDK 2.8.1 published to pypi/npm. Patch includes KV cache compatibility shim and a small backfill migration. Recommend calling out in release notes.

zach: Holding traffic config for 40m to ensure stability. If error stays <1.5% for 15m we can consider soft-unpin, but only after eng-platform updates release notes and we push the SDK advisory.

eng-platform: Release notes updated: "runtime v3.2 pinned regionally (ap-southeast) for quantized models due to KVCACHE regression observed with SDK 2.7. Action: upgrade to SDK 2.8.1 or later. Temporary routing to qn-v4b-lite applied."

sam: Thanks all — leaving the pin in place until 03:00Z or until we get green across 2 canary cycles after SDK adoption. I'll post a follow-up if we unpin or escalate to rollback. :white_check_mark:
